Package com.mimecast.robin.bots

Class BotRetryEntry

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.bots.BotRetryEntry
public class BotRetryEntry extends Object
A report bot endpoint request waiting to be sent again.

Stored as one JSON file per request by BotRetrySpool. Headers are kept as they were sent, since Magic values in authValue and headers come from the SMTP session that delivered the report and are not available when the request is retried.
